adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a native `fetch` `Response` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, but otherwise returns whatever `refreshFunction()` returns (typed `() => any`). Call sites assume different shapes: e.g. Hubspot assigns `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` (expects a token object), and Zoho/Bigin later access `.data` on the result (expects an Axios response). If credential sharing is enabled, they will instead receive a `Response` (no `.data`, not a `HubspotToken`), causing broken runtime behavior. The overly-permissive `any` typing masks this mismatch rather than preventing it.
